subtitle.zh: 来源：RFC 0052 · ckb-production-scripts/c/xudt_rce.c（master）+ c/rce.h 错误码　·　Mirana code_hash 0x50bd…1b95，hash_type data1
subtitle.en: Source: RFC 0052 · ckb-production-scripts/c/xudt_rce.c (master) + c/rce.h error codes　·　Mirana code_hash 0x50bd…1b95, hash_type data1

title.zh: 发行 / 增发（owner 模式）

cond.zh: 满足任一启用的 owner 条件时跳过数量检查（扩展脚本仍执行）
cond.en: when any enabled owner condition holds, the amount check is skipped (extension scripts still run)

role.zh: 低位：0 无扩展 / 1 扩展在 args / 2 扩展在 witness；高 3 位：owner 模式开关
role.en: low bits: 0 no extension / 1 extensions in args / 2 extensions in witness; top 3 bits: owner-mode switches

role.zh: flags=1：ScriptVec；flags=2：20 字节 blake160(witness 中的 ScriptVec)
role.en: flags=1: ScriptVec; flags=2: 20-byte blake160 of the ScriptVec in the witness

cons.zh: flags=1 长度须与 ScriptVec 一致；flags=2 须为 20 字节且 hash 匹配
cons.en: flags=1 length must match the ScriptVec; flags=2 must be 20 bytes and the hash must match

cond.zh: 长度 ≥ 16 字节，前 16 字节为 u128 LE
cond.en: length ≥ 16 bytes; first 16 bytes are u128 LE

cond.zh: 每个扩展脚本的 validate 必须返回 0
cond.en: each extension script's validate must return 0

note.zh: 具体错误码由扩展脚本决定
note.en: error codes depend on the extension

notes.zh: 错误码数值来自 c/rce.h 枚举（ERROR_INVALID_FLAG=44，ERROR_INVALID_ARGS_FORMAT=45，ERROR_HASH_MISMATCHED=49）；以 master 源码为准，已部署版本可能略有差异
notes.en: Numeric error codes come from the c/rce.h enum (ERROR_INVALID_FLAG=44, ERROR_INVALID_ARGS_FORMAT=45, ERROR_HASH_MISMATCHED=49); based on master, the deployed build may differ slightly
